notes.title: Remodels of CA instances
notes.content: Added in new remodels of CA instances for CA1, CA3, and CA5. This also comes with some slight light changes, handling adjustments, and other minor details that have been adjusted.

notes.title: Remodels of AJ7 instances
notes.content:
Added in newer models for 3 of the junkyard instances, AJ7-1, AJ7-2 and AJ7-4, pulled from the latest game in the series Junkyard Fury Breakout (feel free to check it out!), as well as making some changes to materials and textures to make it match the original feel.

Also made some material and texture changes to the junkyard environment itself.

notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.content: Added a new season system that will adjust the original junkyard, as well as the menu, to winter if its December

notes.title: Quick patch - added virtual keyboard
notes.content: Added virtual keyboard to the mod.io UI, for inputing your email for authentication as well as the code that is sent to you.

notes.title: Graphical update, menus
notes.content:
Added new graphical enhancements, can now change the quality, color intensity, and bloom intensity through the main menu. Also added options in the pause menu that allow you to adjust the sensitivity during game, as well as allowing you to invert controls. 

This also comes with a fix to the pause menu, where it would stay stuck to the screen. Issue should be resolved.

notes.title: CA1 Update
notes.content: CA1 has been changed, mechanic for the car has been altered. Level is relatively the same, but the mood has been adjusted a bit.

notes.title: Quick patch
notes.content: A few things were out of order. CA4 had not shown up, that has now been fixed. The conclusion ending showed some glitches, should look better now.

notes.title: Quick Patch
notes.content: A quick patch to the latest update, CA3. Glitch where you fall through the floor shouldn't be an issue anymore

notes.title: Updated joystick movement, level 4 update
notes.content: Joystick movement has been worked on. Previously, the left joystick only moved the player forward and back, now it moves the player left and right as well. Level 4 has been updated to make it easier to find where to place ET instances, giving the user a radar that indicates the position (when close)

notes.title: Quick patch, other changes
notes.content: Quick patch to the menus. There was a glitch that would prevent the second menu from popping up under certain circumstances, should be patched now. Some environmental changes, touched up a few mechanics

notes.title: Quick patch, small changes
notes.content: There has been a quick patch to AJ7-2 in terms of response. AJ7-2 originally read mouse input when staying still, but in a previous update, it was taken out by accident. AJ7-2 now reads mouse input again. Other small changes, environmental and adjusted lighting

notes.title: Small update to menus
notes.content: Quick update for the menus, specifically if a player wins the normal ending, but not the secret ending, they'll be given the menu that allows them to play previous levels, just with the secret level locked. Made more sense to adjust it this way.

notes.title: Update 10/10/2021, small graphic changes
notes.content: More small graphic changes have been made, this time for the cars

notes.title: Update 10/09/2021, Graphic changes
notes.content: Graphics have been worked on, added a high quality setting with intended effects
